title: Default Mirror Activation shortcut conflicts with non-US keyboard layouts
author: lennartb-

status.label: clear international-hotkey design candidate
status.detail: The conflict is reproducible on German and Danish layouts and aligns with an older ZoomIt AltGr conflict report.

next_action.label: Complete safe-hotkey design
next_action.reason: Keep design_in_progress until migration and layout-aware tests are specified.

judgment.rationale: The conflict is reproducible on German and Danish layouts, affects a newly enabled default ZoomIt hotkey, and aligns with an older international-layout ZoomIt conflict report.
evidence: AltGr+9 produces ] on German and Danish layouts but triggers DemoMirror through Ctrl+Alt+9 equivalence.
Changing DemoMirror to Ctrl+0 moves the collision to AltGr+0.
#48377 tracks the same class of ZoomIt defaults consuming international AltGr input.
judgment.recommended_action: Continue full design work on safe defaults and layout-aware validation; keep design_in_progress until exact symbols and tests are specified.

issue_context.summary: ZoomIt DemoMirror’s default Ctrl+Alt+9 binding collides with AltGr character entry on non-US layouts.
known_information: German and Danish repros are supplied.
Changing the hotkey moves the collision to the corresponding AltGr combination.
A diagnostic archive is attached, though automated analysis rejected it as oversized.
inferences: The problem is systemic to Ctrl+Alt shortcuts that overlap AltGr output, not limited to one key or layout.
issue_context.analysis: The evidence supports design work, but the fix must choose among safer defaults, migration, and layout-aware warnings.
initial_investigation: Inspected ZoomIt DemoMirror hotkey code and related issues #48377 and #36313.
Confirmed no linked fix PR on the target issue.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Resolve in full design using ZoomIt settings persistence and release migration behavior.

information_gaps.why_needed: Prevents replacing one international shortcut collision with another.
